reason: The claim states both the 2024-09-12 launch and the state after the 2024-11-21 feature-plan model; the current feature plans table still lists email MFA as Essentials + Plus, and no later item changes it.
The 2026-07-06 What's New item on self-service provisioned API rate limits confirms the same change; no later item reverses it.
No later change item touches SAML; the current 'Things to know about SAML IdPs' page still says Cognito supports SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SSO.
The claim reflects the post-2024-11-22 tier model; the current pricing page and FAQ still state 10,000 MAUs and the legacy 50,000 MAUs; the 2025-11-03 M2M price change does not touch MAU free tiers.
The price is from the current pricing page example written for the 2024-11 tier model; no later change item alters the Essentials MAU price.
The current pricing page Plus example still shows a 0 MAU free tier and $0.020 per MAU; no later change item alters Plus pricing.
The current pricing page Free Tier section still says there is no free tier for the Plus tier; no later item changes it.

The claim already includes the 2026-07-29 GetClientToken change (supported through PrivateLink); the later 2026-08-31 What's New item is the same feature and the 2026-10-01 WAF item does not touch PrivateLink.
Refresh token rotation dates from 2025-04-22; later items (client secret rotation, GetClientToken, resource indicators) do not change which API refreshes tokens with rotation on.
The claim includes the 2026-07-31 change that Cognito Sync is no longer open to new customers; no later item changes the sync store further.
The 2026-07-30 item adds the console and CLI paths but keeps the API path; the current upgrade guide page still names the UpdateDirectorySetup API, so the dated claim remains true.
The current multi-Region replication guide page still lists Middle East (Bahrain) and Middle East (UAE) as the opt-in Regions where replication is unavailable; no later item changes it.
The claim reflects the 2025-08-15 increase; the current quotas page shows 25, 500 and 125, and no later item changes sharing limits.
The claim includes the 2026-07-30 Simple AD closure to new customers; later items (Private CA connector in GovCloud) do not change the directory choices.
Later items (multi-Region, optional multi-account permissions, ARN support) do not change the account instance availability conditions, which the current page still lists.
None of the change items alters the user interactive session default or range; the current page still says 8 hours, from 15 minutes to 90 days.
